title: Tencent Releases Hy4, an AI Model for 3D Creation

opening.say: This is Mono Radio. Good morning, it's Monday, November twenty-third.
opening.show: This is Mono Radio. Good morning, it's Monday, November 23.

opening.say: Today we have five stories from the world of A I and three D.
opening.show: Today we have five stories from the world of AI and 3D.

news.label: Tencent Releases Hy4
points: Trained on Blender and CAD use
details: It is a large multimodal MoE model, with a language component of 770 billion total parameters and support for a one million token context.
Training also strengthens on-screen operation of specialist software such as Blender and CAD, plus game development for Unreal Engine, Unity and Godot.
The weights are public, but the model is huge and is not a lightweight one that runs on a typical personal GPU.

lines.say: First up, Tencent. The weights for an A I model called Hy four have been released.
lines.show: First up, Tencent. The weights for an AI model called Hy4 have been released.

lines.say: What's interesting is that it has learned to operate Blender and CAD on screen.
lines.show: What's interesting is that it has learned to operate Blender and CAD on screen.

lines.say: But it's very large, so it won't run on an ordinary computer.
lines.show: But it's very large, so it won't run on an ordinary computer.

link.title: tencent/Hy4 · Hugging Face
link.description: Image-Text-to-Text model with 774B parameters. Download, explore files and run it on Hugging Face.

news.label: AI Improves Chip Circuit Design
points: Up to 14% gain in some blocks
details: The model edits RTL code and improves it while checking functional equivalence with Synopsys tools.
On a specific IP block of a flagship GPU, PPA improved by up to 14 percent over a highly optimized design.
That does not mean the whole GPU got 14 percent faster.

lines.say: Next, semiconductors. OpenAI and A M D used A I to improve a circuit design.
lines.show: Next, semiconductors. OpenAI and AMD used AI to improve a circuit design.

lines.say: In some blocks of a G P U, they saw gains of up to fourteen percent.
lines.show: In some blocks of a GPU, they saw gains of up to 14 percent.

lines.say: And some of the suggestions were included in a design that went on to manufacturing.
lines.show: And some of the suggestions were included in a design that went on to manufacturing.

link.title: OpenAI モデルによるチップ設計の進化
link.description: OpenAI モデルが Jalapeño チップの回路を最適化し、RISC‑V コアの設計を改良。GPT‑6 Astra による AI 支援型チップ設計の進歩を紹介します。

news.label: XJet Announces Atelier
points: Charm designs from text or photos
details: You can design from a short description or a photo, then preview the adjusted shape in 360 degrees.
It connects to a real manufacturing process using the company's NanoParticle Jetting method.
It is a service that lets you have parts made on contract without owning a printer.

lines.say: Now, metal three D printing. XJet has announced Atelier, which makes metal jewelry from text or photos.
lines.show: Now, metal 3D printing. XJet has announced Atelier, which makes metal jewelry from text or photos.

lines.say: I like that you can check the shape in three hundred sixty degrees and go straight to making the real thing.
lines.show: I like that you can check the shape in 360 degrees and go straight to making the real thing.

news.label: Physical AI Arrives in a Hospital
details: It handles opened medicine boxes, which were hard for conventional automated equipment because of warped boxes and glossy reflections.
The hospital introduced a system that manages stock and dispensing, along with an automatic storage device called Ultra Facis.
It aims to automate the scanning and transport work that staff used to do box by box.

lines.say: Now for some robot news. A hospital in Osaka has introduced physical A I equipment that can even handle opened medicine boxes.
lines.show: Now for some robot news. A hospital in Osaka has introduced physical AI equipment that can even handle opened medicine boxes.

lines.say: Handling real objects that vary in shape and condition is impressive, isn't it?

Content can be updated using information from connected apps, and charts and interactive elements can be included.
